about: Every slot of a theme appearance, what it means and where the viewer uses it. Shared by the viewer's tests (map-viewer/test), relay-server/themes.py (check, derive, list) and docs/map-viewer-api.md. A theme supplies colours; the diagram decides what they mean. Slots marked required must be given; the rest are filled in from bg, ink and the swatches when left out (the viewer warns theme-filled for the main ones, quietly for frame and the player's roles).

theme.use: the theme's id: letters, digits, - and _; in .themes/ the file name
the name in the viewer's theme picker (name in a .themes/ file)
.themes/ only: the theme's name, for people and agents
.themes/ only: what the theme is for, so an agent can choose (themes.py list)

{family, faces: [{weight, style, data}]}; in .themes/ each face's data is a file beside the theme ({family, faces: [{weight, style, file}]} or {family, file}). Needed: 400, 600, 700, each plain and italic; a missing weight borrows the nearest
light and/or dark: at least one
extra CSS for the theme's classes (map-viewer-api.md lists them)

appearance.use: the drawing's background; every contrast is checked against it
colours told apart: a mind map's branches, a box diagram's and an ER diagram's classes (the table classes take slots 1 to 5); lines take their node's colour. Repeats after the last
a ramp by depth, the centre first (colour by level)
secondary text: arrow labels, region outlines, what is not lit
focus rings, the colour of nodes with no class (colour by class; every table of an ER diagram with no classes)
how much of a node's colour fills its box in the outline look (0 to 100)
added (colour by changes), a good trust mark
removed (colour by changes), errors, what a load took away
search hits, change marks (the sparkle), notes in a sequence
a mind map's related links drawn over the tree
box fill of what a sequence has not reached, and of what a highlight leaves out
outlines and lines of what is idle
a host's bar round the viewer (the atlas's contents bar)
icon swatch red (an icon's colour in the map's ## Icons)

checks.about: both: the viewer (themes/theme.js checkTheme) and themes.py check report them alike, held in step by format/theme-samples/. checker: themes.py only (colour blindness, a .themes/ font file, a missing description).
